info.title: Trà Đá Mentor Hub API
info.description: REST API for mentoring program operations. Authenticated routes require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. List endpoints return a raw array unless `page` is set, in which case the body is `{ data, page, limit, total }`. Errors use `{ success: false, code, message }`.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and issue a new access token

get.description: Returns Mentor[] unless page is provided.

post.summary: Add a mentee to a group

delete.summary: Remove a mentee from a group

patch.summary: Book slot for the signed-in mentee
patch.description: Non-admin callers ignore menteeId. Admin may pass menteeId.

patch.summary: Reschedule a slot owned by the mentor

get.summary: List session logs scoped to the caller

post.summary: Create or update a session log

get.summary: Explain one mentor and mentee pair

post.summary: Sync a slot to Google Calendar
Upload an avatar for the caller's own profile
